## What lands

- **`crates/hh-eval/src/comparative_estimators.rs`** — the §6.4 admission-map apparatus, all on the admitted §4.3 machinery and the population contract's one counting rule:
  - `finite_manifest_rate` — single-arm θ_h: Beta(1,1) cells, 8,000 draws + doubling; IS the contrast machinery's per-arm marginal (new `finite_manifest::arm_marginal_interval` over the shared `cell_posterior_draws`), interval+doubling asserted equal in tests; all-planned `[s/M,(s+u)/M]` bound beside (`population::arm_bounds`).
  - `rerun_flip` `2c(k−c)/(k(k−1))` — unbiased under constant p (exact binomial-enumeration test); `swap_flip` `p̂_g(1−p̂_h)+p̂_h(1−p̂_g)` + `harness_excess` `f_swap − ½(f_g+f_h)` with its own interval (`= mean_t (p_g−p_h)²` in expectation — REQ-XF-123's member verbatim).
  - `cost_routes` — $/trial mean + clustered task bootstrap + tails; $/solve ratio with task-resampled interval; typed `estimator_undefined` at 0 solves; declared provenance label required.
  - `pass_rates` — mean_t pass^k/pass@k for the §6.11 row; `tied_with_leader` — argmax-θ̂ leader, tied iff the task-bootstrap 95% Δ interval covers 0, selection-caveat labels, equivalence/non-inferiority claims refuse `UnsupportedClaim` (REQ-XD-031).
  - `comparative_estimand` — θ_h/Δ(h−ref) (REQ-XD-001): unresolved/short cells name the involving contrast's `refusal` (§6.8 REQ-XD-061); all-planned bounds + completion envelope publish; eligible-only is a labelled `conditional secondary`.
  - `confirmatory_family` — per-tranche many-to-one Δ(h−ref) under `capability.task_success`/joint population, sharp-null sign-flip p, Holm α=.05; exploratory BH over other pairs; unavailable members retained at worst mass (§10.1.3).
  - `validate_results_packet` — `hh-comparative-results/1` (C-33): every §6.11 quantity + intervals + mandatory labels (REQ-XD-092 substrings), `harness_excess` intervals, per-arm `counts{analysis_basis,intended,served}`, three populations, typed absent states.
- **`finite_manifest.rs`** — `cell_posterior_draws` + `endpoint_ladder` factored (bit-identical draw order — golden batteries unchanged); `arm_marginal_interval` exported.
- **`population.rs`** — `arm_bounds` through `contrib`; **`comparative_protocol.rs`** — `randomization_digest` + `ScheduleEvidence::check()`.
- **`task_mixture.rs`** — `slot_schedule_randomization` admitted beside `lane_randomization` on the sign-flip path: requires a recomputing randomization record (`ExchangeabilityNotAdmitted`/`RandomizationRecord`); gated uses need GATE-G23 (`MethodNotAdmitted`); report records the actual exchangeability spelling; `lane_randomization` batteries byte-unchanged.
- **`hh-analysis/kernel.rs`** — `filters.schedule_randomization`/`use_class`/`admission` decode into `TaskMixtureDecl` (routing plumbing — no second implementation).
